title: A bot and a named group have canonical conversations
description:
As an organization member, I want each bot to have one durable direct conversation and named multi-bot groups to have one durable channel, so that the roster never behaves like a list of sessions.

Feature: Canonical workspace conversations

Scenario: Reopening an individual bot
Given an organization member and a named bot
When the member opens that bot repeatedly
Then Chatticus returns the same direct channel
And the direct channel has exactly that human and bot

Scenario: Opening a named multi-bot channel
Given an organization member and multiple named bots
When the member creates a named channel with those bots
Then the channel stores its name and participants
And it is listed distinctly from individual bots

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Local implementation and executable scenarios now cover idempotent direct channels, stored named channels and participants, and preservation of a migrated direct channel ID. Development audit found migration blockers tracked in chatticus-be9e3e; no migration has been applied.
